## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `main` with a descriptive name (`fix/`, `feat/`, `docs/`)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` introduces no new errors
- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds
- [ ] For scoring/crawler changes: ran an audit end-to-end and the report populates
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, or `data/` contents committed
- [ ] Updated docs (README / CLAUDE.md) if behavior or setup changed
